descriptions.id: Penjelasan mendalam catatan kunjungan vet tanpa bertele-tele: arti praktisnya, versi paling kecil untuk memulai, dan cara datanya tersimpan di perangkat.
descriptions.en: A deep dive into the vet visit log without the runaround: what it means in practice, the smallest version to start, and how the data is stored.
